## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run check`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` pass (if Rust changed)
- [ ] New UI strings added to `en`, `es`, and `zh`
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, real documents, telemetry, or new network calls
- [ ] Docs/CHANGELOG updated; PR title has `[skip release]` if this should not ship a version
